playerEdit.hint: Players can change this condition on units they own. The GM can always change it.

contrast.name: Ring and pip colours
contrast.hint: High contrast uses colour-blind-friendly colours, a green frame, solid pips with dark text, and brighter labels. Just for you; other players keep their own choice.

ringStyle.name: Ring style
ringStyle.hint: Classic: each wedge outlined, wedges that open another ring outlined in the accent colour. Mod frame: one metal frame round the whole ring with glowing dividers, after Warframe's mod borders.

showPips.name: Show condition pips on tokens
showPips.hint: Small labels above each token showing its active conditions and levels.
